pages.text: Physics apply to your fleet! The Zephyr Hauler features a $(2)Dynamic Weight$() system. The more items you have stored inside the chest, barrel, or machine you are transporting, the heavier the cargo becomes.

pages.title: Weight Penalties
pages.text: $(2)Light/Medium:$() Safe and fast.$(br)$(2)Heavy/Overloaded:$() Sluggish ascent. 30% chance to take structural damage upon landing due to high inertia.$(br)$(4)Colossal (>54 Stacks):$() Barely flies. Falls like an anvil and takes $(4)guaranteed severe damage$() without proper upgrades.

pages.title: Cargo Density
pages.text: *(Placeholder)* Keep an eye on how full your transported containers are; weight is calculated dynamically block by block.

pages.title: Countering Weight:
pages.text: If you must move massive shipments of heavy resources, compensate for the drag by burning high-tier fuels like $(2)Soul Sand$() or $(2)Wind Charges$(), or permanently install the $(2)Aerodynamic$() upgrade.
